<b>Silkspeed Anklets</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Yellow|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. At the cost of slowly draining [[Silk]], it increases grounded [[Swift Step|sprinting]] speed by 34% while equipped.

== Usefulness ==
While [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] sprints on the ground for roughly six seconds, the Silkspeed Anklets will consume one unit of Silk. The roughly six seconds of sprinting to consume Silk is remembered if Hornet stops sprinting, then continues sprinting, so long as she continues in under four seconds. If Hornet sprints on the ground for roughly one second, stops, then sprints for roughly five seconds, one unit of Silk will still be consumed. The Silkspeed Anklets will not grant additional speed or drain Silk if Hornet is in the air. If Hornet has Silk and sprints, the Silk drain that the Silkspeed Anklets cause will completely stop and restart the regeneration process of a unit of Silk caused by [[Silk Heart]]s and [[Weavelight]]. If Hornet has no Silk, then the Silkspeed Anklets have no effect and will not prevent Silk from regenerating.

The extra movement speed granted by the Silkspeed Anklets is useful for exploration and combat. The applications in exploration can allow Hornet to get to her destinations faster, especially when exploring previous areas again. The applications in combat can allow Hornet to dodge attacks more easily and run back to a vulnerable enemy in less time.

Can be useful in completing [[Wishes#Delivery Wishes|Delivery Wishes]] more quickly, particularly [[Courier's Rasher]] as the delivery is time-limited.

== How to Acquire ==
Found inside [[Weavenest Cindril]], on the far east of [[Far Fields]]. Acquired by running across all the pressure plates with [[Swift Step]].
